name: ballerina/ftp
description: This module provides an FTP/SFTP client and an FTP/SFTP server listener implementation to facilitate an FTP/SFTP connection connected to a remote location. Additionally, it supports FTPS (FTP over SSL/TLS) to facilitate secure file transfers.

typeDefs.name: FtpFunctionConfig
typeDefs.description:
Configuration for FTP service remote functions.
Use this to override default file extension routing for content methods.

fields.name: fileNamePattern
fields.description:
File name pattern (regex) that should be routed to this method.
Must be a subset of the listener's `fileNamePattern`.

typeDefs.name: FileWriteOption
typeDefs.description:
File write options for write operations.
OVERWRITE - Overwrite the existing file content
APPEND - Append to the existing file content

typeDefs.name: Compression
typeDefs.description:
Compression type for file uploads.
ZIP - Zip compression
NONE - No compression

typeDefs.name: ClientConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Configuration for FTP client.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Protocol to use for the connection: FTP (unsecure) or SFTP (over SSH)

fields.name: host
fields.description: Target server hostname or IP address

fields.name: port
fields.description:
Port number of the remote service. 
For FTPS IMPLICIT, this is typically 990. 
For FTPS EXPLICIT and FTP, this is typically 21.

fields.name: auth
fields.description: Authentication options for connecting to the server

fields.name: userDirIsRoot
fields.description:
If set to `true`, treats the login home directory as the root (`/`) and
prevents the underlying VFS from attempting to change to the actual server root.
If `false`, treats the actual server root as `/`, which may cause a `CWD /` command
that can fail on servers restricting root access (e.g., chrooted environments).

If set to `true`, enables relaxed data binding for XML and JSON responses.
null values in JSON/XML are allowed to be mapped to optional fields
missing fields in JSON/XML are allowed to be mapped as null values

typeDefs.name: Protocol
typeDefs.description:
Protocol to use for FTP server connections.
Determines whether to use basic FTP, FTPS, or SFTP.
FTP - Unsecure File Transfer Protocol
FTPS - Secure File Transfer Protocol (FTP over SSL/TLS)
SFTP - File Transfer Protocol over SSH

typeDefs.name: AuthConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Specifies authentication options for FTP server connections.

fields.name: credentials
fields.description: Username and password for basic authentication

fields.name: privateKey
fields.description: Private key and password for SSH-based authentication (used with SFTP protocol)

fields.name: secureSocket
fields.description: Secure socket configuration for SSL/TLS (used with FTPS protocol)

fields.name: preferredMethods
fields.description: Preferred authentication methods (used with SFTP protocol)

typeDefs.name: Credentials
typeDefs.description: Basic authentication credentials for connecting to FTP/FTPS servers using username and password.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Username for authentication

fields.name: password
fields.description: Optional password for authentication

typeDefs.name: PrivateKey
typeDefs.description: Private key configuration for SSH-based authentication (used with SFTP).

fields.name: path
fields.description: Path to the private key file

fields.name: password
fields.description: Optional password for the private key

typeDefs.name: SecureSocket
typeDefs.description:
Secure socket configuration for FTPS (FTP over SSL/TLS).
Used for configuring SSL/TLS certificates and keystores for FTPS connections.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Keystore configuration for client authentication

fields.name: cert
fields.description: Certificate configuration for server certificate validation

fields.name: mode
fields.description: FTPS connection mode (IMPLICIT or EXPLICIT). Defaults to EXPLICIT if not specified.

fields.name: dataChannelProtection
fields.description:
Data channel protection level (CLEAR, PRIVATE, SAFE, or CONFIDENTIAL).
Controls encryption of the data channel used for file transfers.
Defaults to PRIVATE (encrypted) for secure transfers.

typeDefs.name: FtpsMode
typeDefs.description:
FTPS connection mode.
IMPLICIT - SSL/TLS connection is established immediately upon connection. 
Note: The port must be explicitly set (standard port is 990).
EXPLICIT - Starts as regular FTP, then upgrades to SSL/TLS using AUTH TLS command.
Note: The port must be explicitly set (standard port is 21).

typeDefs.name: FtpsDataChannelProtection
typeDefs.description:
FTPS data channel protection level.
Controls whether the data channel (file transfers) is encrypted.
CLEAR - Data channel is not encrypted (PROT C). Not recommended for security.
PRIVATE - Data channel is encrypted (PROT P). Recommended for secure transfers.
SAFE - Data channel has integrity protection only (PROT S). Rarely used.
CONFIDENTIAL - Data channel is encrypted (PROT E). Similar to PRIVATE.

typeDefs.name: PreferredMethod
typeDefs.description:
Authentication methods to use when connecting to FTP/SFTP servers.

KEYBOARD_INTERACTIVE - Keyboard interactive authentication (user prompted for credentials)
GSSAPI_WITH_MIC - GSSAPI with MIC (Generic Security Service Application Program Interface)
PASSWORD - Password-based authentication using username and password
PUBLICKEY - Public key-based authentication using SSH key pairs

fields.name: sftpSessionTimeout

typeDefs.name: AgeCalculationMode
typeDefs.description:
Determines the timestamp used when calculating file age for filtering.

LAST_MODIFIED - Use file's last modified timestamp (default)
CREATION_TIME - Use file's creation timestamp (where supported by file system)

typeDefs.name: FileAgeFilter
typeDefs.description:
Filters files based on their age to control which files trigger listener events.
Useful for processing only files within a specific age range (e.g., skip very new files or very old files).

fields.name: minAge
fields.description:
Minimum age of file in seconds since last modification/creation (inclusive).
Files younger than this will be skipped. If not specified, no minimum age requirement.

fields.name: maxAge
fields.description:
Maximum age of file in seconds since last modification/creation (inclusive).
Files older than this will be skipped. If not specified, no maximum age requirement.

fields.name: ageCalculationMode
fields.description: Whether to calculate age based on last modified time or creation time

typeDefs.name: DependencyMatchingMode
typeDefs.description:
Determines how to match required files when evaluating file dependencies.
Controls whether all dependencies must be present, at least one, or a specific count.
ALL - All required file patterns must have at least one matching file (default)
ANY - At least one required file pattern must have a matching file
EXACT_COUNT - Exact number of required files must match (count specified in requiredFileCount)

typeDefs.name: FileDependencyCondition
typeDefs.description:
Defines a dependency condition where processing of target files depends on the existence of other files.
This allows conditional file processing based on the presence of related files (e.g., processing a data file only
when a corresponding marker file exists). Supports capture group substitution to dynamically match related files.

fields.name: targetPattern
fields.description: Regex pattern for files that should be processed conditionally

fields.name: requiredFiles
fields.description: Array of file patterns that must exist. Supports capture group substitution (e.g., "$1")

fields.name: matchingMode
fields.description: How to match required files (ALL, ANY, or EXACT_COUNT)

fields.name: requiredFileCount
fields.description: For EXACT_COUNT mode, specifies the exact number of required files

functions.name: next
functions.description: Reads and return the next `byte[]` chunk of the stream.

return.description:
A `record` of `byte[]`s when the stream is available,
`()` if the stream has reached the end or else an `error`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the stream. The primary usage of this function is to close the stream without reaching the end.
If the stream reaches the end, the `contentByteStream.next` will automatically close the stream.

return.description: Returns `()` when the closing was successful or an `error`

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts the FTP listener and begins monitoring for file changes.
```ballerina
error? response = listener.'start();
```

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Attaches an FTP service to the listener.
```ballerina
error? response = listener.attach(service1);
```

parameters.name: ftpService
parameters.description: Service to be attached to the listener

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional name for the service

return.description: `()` or else an `error` upon failure to attach the service

functions.description:
Stops the FTP listener and detaches the service.
```ballerina
error? response = listener.detach(service1);
```

return.description: `()` or else an `error` upon failure to detach the service


functions.name: gracefulStop



clients.name: Client
clients.description:
FTP client for connecting to and managing FTP/SFTP servers.
Supports reading files in various formats (text, JSON, XML, CSV, bytes) and writing files with overwrite or append options.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Gets invoked during object initialization.

parameters.name: clientConfig
parameters.description: Configurations for FTP client

return.description: `ftp:Error` in case of errors or `()` otherwise

functions.name: get
functions.description:
Retrieves the file content from a remote resource.
```ballerina
stream<byte[] & readonly, io:Error?>|ftp:Error channel = client->get(path);
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The resource path

return.description: A byte stream from which the file can be read or `ftp:Error` in case of errors

functions.name: getBytes
functions.description:
Retrieves the file content as bytes from a remote resource.
```ballerina
byte[] content = check client->getBytes(path);
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The resource path

return.description: Content as a byte array or `ftp:Error` in case of errors

functions.name: getText
functions.description:
Retrieves the file content as text from a remote resource.
```ballerina
string content = check client->getText(path);
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The resource path

return.description: Content as a string or `ftp:Error` in case of errors

functions.name: getJson
functions.description:
Retrieves the file content as JSON from a remote resource.
```ballerina
json content = check client->getJson(path);
```

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The resource path

parameters.name: targetType
parameters.description:
Expected return type (to be used for automatic data binding).
Supported types:
- Built-in `json` type
- Custom types (e.g., `User`, `Student?`, `Person[]`, etc.)

return.description: Content as JSON or `ftp:Error` in case of errors

functions.name: getXml
functions.description:
Retrieves the file content as XML from a remote resource.

parameters.name: path

parameters.name: targetType
parameters.description:
Expected return type (to be used for automatic data binding).

return.description: Content as XML or `ftp:Error` in case of errors

functions.name: getCsv

Retrieves the file content as CSV from a remote resource.


parameters.name: path

parameters.name: targetType

Expected return type (to be used for automatic data binding).
Supported types:
- Built-in types: `string[][]` (array of string arrays)
- Custom types: (e.g., `User[]`, `Student[]`, `Person[]`, etc.)

return.description: Content as CSV or `ftp:Error` in case of errors

methods.name: onFileCsv
methods.description: Triggered when a CSV file is added to the monitored FTP location. Supports raw 2D string arrays, data binding to custom record types, and streaming for large files

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: CSV file content. Can be string[][] for raw rows, record{}[] for data-bound rows, stream<string[]> for streaming raw rows from large files, or stream<record{}> for streaming data-bound rows

parameters.name: fileInfo
parameters.description: Additional file properties such as size, modification time, and permissions

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Optional FTP connection for performing additional file operations (move, delete) within this handler
